entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The unified forces of Dominaria that resisted the Phyrexian Invasion, organized by Urza.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Dominaria resisted by the Coalition.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Organized the Coalition after thousands of years of preparation.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Controlled the denizens of Yavimaya among the Coalition's first members.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: Metathran commander who led the assault on Urborg.

entities.name: Thaddeus
entities.description: Metathran commander who led at Koilos and died there.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Succeeded Thaddeus as leader of half the Coalition forces; fought in the Battle of Twilight.

entities.name: Commander Grizzlegom
entities.description: Fought alongside Agnate in the assault on Urborg.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Led Dominaria's dragons to protect Shiv.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Whose machinations affected the dragons' quest to revive the Primevals.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Rescued by the Coalition before Yawgmoth appeared.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian god whose appearance destroyed most of the Coalition at Urborg; destroyed or banished by the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who erected the Martyrs' Tomb.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Urza's flagship at Koilos.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: Force that joined the fray at Koilos and assaulted Phyrexia.

entities.name: Battle of Koilos
entities.description: First large Coalition confrontation, at the Phyrexian stronghold in ancient Halcyon.

entities.name: Battle at Urborg
entities.description: Coalition assault on the Stronghold that ended with Yawgmoth's appearance.

entities.name: Legacy Weapon
entities.description: Weapon whose activation destroyed or banished Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Future seat of Phyrexian power where the Coalition fought.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Site of the ancient Thran city of Halcyon, where the Phyrexians made a stronghold.

entities.name: New Coalition
entities.description: Coalition formed in Dominaria United when New Phyrexia attacked again.

entities.name: Battle of the Mana Rig
entities.description: Battle in which the New Coalition confronted the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Helped turn the Phyrexians back at Urza's Tower.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane defended by the Coalition.

events.summary: Urza organizes the Coalition after thousands of years of preparation.
The Battle of Koilos is fought at the Phyrexian stronghold; after Thaddeus dies Eladamri takes half the forces.
events.quote: After Thaddeus's death, Eladamri succeeded him as leader of half of the Coalition forces.

events.summary: The Coalition divides to focus on several confrontations after the victory at Koilos and the Rathi Overlay.
events.quote: the Coalition forces were divided to focus on several specific confrontations

events.summary: Coalition forces assault the Stronghold at Urborg and stall at the volcano.
events.quote: were halted at a stalemate at the foot of the volcano housing the Stronghold

events.summary: After rescuing Gerrard Capashen, the Coalition faces Yawgmoth, whose appearance destroys most of the forces.
events.quote: destroying most of the Coalition forces in one fell swoop

events.summary: Yawgmoth spreads his influence over Dominaria, causing billions of deaths.
The Legacy Weapon is activated and Yawgmoth is destroyed or banished, ending the Invasion.
events.quote: ending the Phyrexian Invasion and eliminating the need for the Coalition

events.summary: Freyalise erects a Martyrs' Tomb for the fallen.
events.quote: A Martyrs' Tomb was erected by the planeswalker

events.summary: A New Coalition forms and confronts the Phyrexians in the Battle of the Mana Rig.
events.quote: A New Coalition was formed in Dominaria United when New Phyrexia staged another attack.

events.summary: The Phyrexians strike in hundreds of places and are turned back at Urza's Tower with Gaea's help.
events.quote: They were turned back at Urza's Tower with the help of

relations.quote: The Battle of Koilos was led by Urza's Metathran commanders
the Coalition forces were faced with a foe they could not hope to stand against
